toolchain.diagnostic_verifier_hash_note: Added 2026-11-04 after independent review of PR #41: the diagnostic trace binary's sha256 is NOT reproducible across checkout locations. Its build embeds absolute source paths (__FILE__ / assert strings), so the hash depends on where the repository is checked out. A separate-lane rebuild at the same commit got a different hash (prefix 7344600f) with byte-identical verdicts and FS_TRACE lines on all 55 records. Treat the pinned diagnostic hash as a record of this lane's build only. Only the production bin/cp_verify hash (verifier/build.sh) reproduced bit-identically. Neither binary is committed (bin/ is not tracked). Possible follow-up, not done here: -ffile-prefix-map=<REPO>=. in build_trace.py.

seeds_note: No random seeds: the fixture's proof is fixed, every run is deterministic. Five repetitions demonstrate determinism, not independent security trials.
verifier_args: <config> examples/accepted-proof/ivk <request> <reply> examples/accepted-proof/example.proof -id <ID> -j 2 (diagnostic build adds -show-stages so the forked stages' FS_TRACE lines are printed on rejection)
spend: CPU only, no model downloads, no GPU, no paid API
provenance: Same lane as the PR author, fresh worktree at 1bad8ce4 plus this amendment.
